scope: At least one invocation per tool, not exhaustive parameter/branch coverage. Native browser tools built the house. The developer console exercised the remaining copy tools after bridge staleness. Later native recovery and precise follow-up reproductions succeeded.
traceLimit: Console retains 30 clipped calls; model activity retains 100 entries. This manifest is a session coverage record, not a complete historical transcript.
